title: TopologySemanticAvailableSelection
description: One semantic entity that can be selected on the active topology artifact surface.

semanticEntity.description: Domain entity the user means, for example inventory.device or inventory.interface.

surfaceEntity.description: Topology surface entity representing the semantic entity.

targetKind.description: Topology overlay target kind this selection resolves to.

catalogIds.description: Semantic catalog field ids available for predicates or outputs on this selection.

supportedActions.description: Semantic catalog action ids supported for this selection and target kind.

valueSummaries.description: Optional bounded observed value summaries for low-cardinality catalog fields.
